pr_metadata.title: feat(obs): portable work-edition QM-view board (workqmboard.py)
pr_metadata.summary: Adds work_qm_dashboard() — the first portable, $qmgr-scoped work-edition board (spec §7.1): a status+services band, a 3×2 trend grid (rate() on the schema-note §4.1 counters), an empty=healthy ③ Attention services table, and a marked ES-feed seam for Wave 1b — binding only schema-note ibmmq_qmgr_* series, with a drill-link carrying $qmgr to the Queue/channel board.
pr_metadata.notes: Continues the existing origin/feature/964-qm-board (original generator + interim tuning), now finalized. Key review points: (1) ③ Attention is empty=healthy by pushing the filter INTO the PromQL (!= 2 on the two service-status gauges, == 0 on listeners) so healthy services produce no series — not by row color; ① keeps always-on service pills as the calm-state census. (2) Board is QM-scoped and binds ONLY schema-note qmgr-class metrics — no ibmmq_queue_/ibmmq_channel_ (those are the Flow board, #965); every name maps to prometheus-schema-note.md §4.1. (3) ES feed is a clearly-marked SEAM (Wave 1b/#966) — no Loki wired, no ${logs} var. (4) Portable: every panel on ${datasource}, no hardcoded lab QM names; publication-driven trend panels are spanNulls gap-tolerant per the failover finding (§5). vrg-validate GREEN: 1229 passed, 100% coverage. Post-merge Step-7 live-Grafana tuning is human-gated and NOT done here. Citation doc (was Deliverable B) is split into its own task per the 1:1 PR-per-task rule.
